text: {"contradictions":[{"a":"རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའ་ནི་སེམས་བརྟན་པ་སྟེ་དེས་བསྙེམས་པའོ།","b":"རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའ་ཞེས་པ་ནི་སེམས་བརྟན་པའོ། དེས་ང་རྒྱལ་བྱའོ།","kind":"sense","why":"A interprets 'b-snyems-pa' as 'pride/arrogance' (or being proud), while B interprets it as 'pride' (nga-rgyal) as a separate instruction.","certainty":"medium"},{"a":"རྐང་པ་ཞེས་པ་ནི་རྗེ་ངར་རོ།","b":"རྐང་པ་ནི་ལོང་བུའོ།","kind":"sense","why":"A defines 'rkang-pa' as the shin (rje-ngar), while B defines it as the ankle (long-bu).","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.why: A interprets 'b-snyems-pa' as 'pride/arrogance' (or being proud), while B interprets it as 'pride' (nga-rgyal) as a separate instruction.
A defines 'rkang-pa' as the shin (rje-ngar), while B defines it as the ankle (long-bu).
